name: YogaTube
description: A video dataset and benchmark for recognizing yoga actions and poses from instructional videos.
evaluation_method: accuracy (top-1) / per-class accuracy (video-level classification); some pose tasks reported with keypoint/pose error metrics
reputation: A niche, domain-specific video benchmark used by a small community working on human action/pose recognition from instructional videos; moderate citation within that niche.
notes: Domain-specific (yoga) and relatively small compared with large-scale action datasets; class imbalance and varied recording conditions can limit generalization. Non-LLM benchmark; potential label noise from instructional video sources.
